What comes up in Londonderry

3 conditions, and each one is handled differently

Every site is scoped on the day. The table is what the work usually involves here rather than a statement about any particular property.

Farm sheds, stables and outbuildings

Steel and timber frames, cement sheet roofing, concrete pads and old fencing.

How it is handled
Sheeting condition assessed before anything is touched and removed under licence where it is asbestos, then the frames down and the pads broken out.
What does it
Licensed asbestos removalists first, then a midi to large excavator with a grapple and hammer.

Whole property clearance

Everything off a holding that is about to be built on or subdivided.

How it is handled
Taken off by stream rather than pushed into one heap, with anything suspect isolated and sampled before it moves.
What does it
Large excavator with a grapple, mulcher where the vegetation volume suits it, truck and dogs.

Sheds, garages, pools and outbuildings

Partial demolition, and frequently several structures in one scope with a different waste stream against each.

How it is handled
Taken down separately so the streams stay apart. A pool shell is broken out and removed, then the void is backfilled with suitable material and compacted in layers.
What does it
Mini or midi excavator, a hammer for the pool shell, and tippers rather than a truck and dog on the smaller volumes.

Londonderry

What shapes the work on these blocks

  • Large semi rural holdings Room to work, room to separate material, and good machine access on most properties.
  • Sheds, stables and farm structures Frequently more of them than there is house, and often the most weathered material on the property.
  • Old fibro in outbuildings Exposed for decades, which can move it from bonded to friable and change the controls entirely.
  • Long hauls to disposal Distance is a real line in the price out here, and it is set by the classification rather than by proximity.

Londonderry properties are large and the access is generally good, so plant is chosen for the job rather than the gap and a truck and dog can usually stand and turn. The planning item is the haul, because the facility licensed to receive a given classification may be a long way off.

Londonderry questions

What people ask before we start

The shed roof is cracked and crumbling. Is that still bonded asbestos?
Possibly not. Badly weathered or damaged cement sheet can have to be handled as friable, which means a different licence class, tighter controls and air monitoring. The assessment is made on site rather than assumed.
Can you clear a whole property at once?
Yes, and it is usually more efficient. Structures, vegetation, fencing and rubbish come off in a sequence that keeps the streams apart, and the block is left clear and at a workable level.
Is flood affected land a problem for demolition or filling?
It is a planning and design matter rather than a plant one, and it affects what can be filled, built or left. It is worth confirming the constraints on a particular property before a scope is fixed.
Is the asbestos removal a separate engagement?
A separate licence, but not a separate engagement. Licensed asbestos removalists carry out the removal and an independent licensed assessor issues the clearance, while Max holds demolition licence AD214737 and runs the programme across all of it.
